stoppingRule: Run each declared startup and offline-reopen case once, preserving failures without replacement. Jazz uses the migrated native screen subscription with explicit initial-query, subscription-update and materialized-screen evidence. Startup retains canonical 1k/10k/100k restarted/warm cases, observer v3 and its unchanged 90-second deadline. Reopen requires complete native data and a correct screen in a new process with networking blocked. Syncular verifies shared-controller regression. This correctness smoke cannot replace the controlled screen-strategy experiment or establish a performance ranking.
